question: What is the primary benefit of electronic communication in nursing?

options.B: Eliminating the need for physical patient assessments
options.C: Replacing verbal handovers entirely with text
options.D: Faster multidisciplinary collaboration and care coordination

explanation: Digital tools allow healthcare workers to share vital data instantly, speeding up team responses. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h1)

question: How do digital channels help rural health centers in Nigeria?

options.A: By removing the requirement for licensed nursing staff
options.B: By connecting them to urban tertiary hospitals for specialist input
options.C: By providing free electricity for hospital equipment
options.D: By eliminating paper entirely from rural clinics

explanation: Telecommunication bridges geographical gaps, allowing remote clinics to consult with specialists in major cities. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h1)

question: When is an individual digital messaging format most appropriate?

options.A: Publishing the annual nursing department budget
options.B: Notifying the entire staff about a public holiday
options.C: Clarifying a specific medication order with a doctor
options.D: Broadcasting shift handover notes to the whole hospital

explanation: One-on-one chats work best for targeted, private inquiries regarding a single patient or task. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h2)

question: A ward nurse needs to share an urgent emergency response alert with all staff on duty. Which communication level fits best?
explanation: Multi-person group platforms allow simultaneous broadcasting of critical alerts to an entire shift team. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h2)

question: What is a major clinical use of video conferencing tools in nursing?

options.B: Conducting remote follow-up assessments for stable chronic patients
options.C: Performing major surgical operations from a distance
options.D: Printing out physical patient case notes

explanation: Video tools allow nurses to check on stable patients visually without requiring them to travel to the facility. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h3)

question: Why is a stable internet connection essential during a telehealth video consultation?

options.A: To prevent interruptions and ensure clear visual and audio assessment
options.B: To automatically record and store patient vital signs on the cloud
options.C: To comply with hospital billing regulations for nursing staff
options.D: To eliminate the need for documenting care in the medical record

explanation: Poor network quality causes freezing or dropped calls, which can disrupt clinical evaluation and patient trust. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h3)

question: What is the primary purpose of a Learning Management System like Moodle in nursing?

options.A: Managing hospital staff payroll and leave rosters
options.B: Serving as a centralized hub for coursework and student evaluation
options.C: Facilitating direct video calls between nurses and discharged patients
options.D: Monitoring real-time patient heart rates in the intensive care unit

explanation: Moodle and similar systems organize educational content, assignments, and grades in one digital space. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h4)

question: How do Learning Management Systems assist nursing educators with large classes?

options.A: By reducing the number of clinical hours required for graduation
options.B: By replacing classroom lectures with clinical ward placements
options.C: By tracking student engagement and storing assessment scores automatically
options.D: By automatically grading practical bedside nursing procedures

explanation: Automated tracking features save time for educators managing grades and coursework submissions for many students. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h4)

question: What should a nurse use instead of a patient's full name when discussing a case electronically?
explanation: Using anonymized identifiers protects patient privacy during digital communication. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h5)

question: Which of the following actions violates patient data security in nursing communication?

options.A: Using an encrypted hospital-approved messaging app for handovers
options.B: Discussing care plans using patient identification numbers
options.C: Logging out of a shared ward computer after finishing a shift
options.D: Posting a patient's clinical photo on a personal social media account

explanation: Public social media lacks encryption and breaches patient confidentiality laws. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h5)
